title: Handoff sending side: claim issue/collect endpoints, allow-listed send buttons, markdown rendering, DB-backed single-use claims
note: Campaign handoff-2026-09. POST/GET /api/v1/handoff/claims per HANDOFF-STANDARD, handoff.targets + handoff.source_origin settings (default empty → no button), handoff_claims table in SQLite+PG (digest only, body re-rendered), ADMIN_GUIDE 6.4. Receiving side deliberately not built (Postra is not in the standard's format table; mail→document is the natural direction).

title: Expose tracking violations list/allow/forget over REST (/api/admin/tracking/violations)
note: Web UI has the table and buttons; automation/CLI operators cannot read the recorder yet. Recorder lives in webui.Server — would need to move to App or share it.

title: OIDC callback: CompleteOIDC failure → redirect to /ui/login?sso=error instead of rendering on the callback URL
note: Error is rendered inline on the code=… URL; refresh retries the code. Needs error_description passed via session/query. Silent-SSO branch is now merged on this base.

title: Read OIDC runtime once per login render (OIDCConfigured + OIDCAutoLoginEnabled both call SystemSettings)
note: Silent-SSO branch is merged; both helpers now exist on this base and each reads settings. Merge into one helper.

title: Record an incident when OIDC discovery fails in oidcStart
note: BeginOIDC discovery failure is shown inline as 502 on the login page; no incident so admins never see it on /ui/admin/incidents.

title: Add gofmt check to CI (internal/application/incidents.go is currently unformatted)
note: gofmt -l still reports incidents.go on this base. Add a CI step and format the file.

title: Manual local login: honour return_to behind path-rewriting proxies with a relative redirect
note: gate already uses absolute /ui/login, so likely not a real problem; verify before doing.

title: Cache TrackingConfig per request burst instead of reading settings on every UI page
note: secure() reads system settings once per page request (same cost class as gate's NeedsAdminSetup); HandoffTargets adds one more read on the message page only. Only worth it if settings reads show up in profiles; a short TTL cache must still honour NotifySettingsChange.

title: Handoff button on the thread screen: send a whole conversation as one markdown document
note: Claim resource would need a thread: prefix or a second resource kind; render messages oldest-first with the same envelope list. Keep single-message rendering as the base.

title: Return handoff.targets as a parsed array in GET /api/admin/settings (in addition to the raw string)
note: Settings API is a flat string map; a typed field would help CLI tooling but breaks the uniform shape — probably better as a dedicated GET /api/admin/handoff/targets.
